svg.title: furiosa-opt-models architecture
svg.desc: A layer stack. vLLM and SGLang run on the furiosa-opt-vllm and furiosa-opt-sglang plugins; Furiosa LLM, coming soon, runs on the engine directly. The plugins, the engine and the models make up the furiosa-opt-models repository, and the models run on the RNGD accelerator.
